bullets.content: [general] Score is (g/2)^2/c below target. Pick by estimated base = ((0.3186/(1.22*eta))/2)^2/(DOFs/6057), eta = estimate/compare value, after ranking by energy gained per DOF. Don't call a compare diff 'noise': 14-15% diffs came with 0.6-0.7% energy rises. Highest energy alone is unreliable.

[general] Start near final h and change exactly ONE factor per solve (two changes gave unattributable results: compare 15.1%; wall 0.0048+root 0.0022 gave SE -0.08%). If two look promising, solve each alone vs the same base. Use all 4 solves; view(kind=error) after each.

[general] Read mesh()'s 'element size near each group' BEFORE every solve. If a targeted group's h is within 10% of global h (not >=1.3x below), the refinement failed: fix with free mesh() calls, never a solve. After EVERY solve view(kind=error) and check hotspot local h <= requested x1.1.
[general] After every solve: view(kind=error), read hotspot local h, and compare(previous, current). I keep skipping view(error); do it before choosing a submit.

[general] Don't re-run an identical mesh as a 'noise control' (deterministic). Avoid near-identical box/edge tweaks (energy 2.1337e-4 vs 2.1319e-4 taught nothing): make one bold change (h, order or targets) for diversity and hidden-point bonus.

[general] Once error is well under target, score depends on DOFs and error together. Spend solves on DOF cuts; submit the cheapest of equal-energy solves. compare() the two finalists; a diff under ~5% is a tie: submit the cheaper. Use all 4 solves, but never solve a candidate with more nodes than the base without a changed error band.

[general] Point refinements are nearly inert: 8 points at 0.0026 r0.005 left hotspot h 0.0053-0.0060; 0.0026->0.0022 changed nodes 5711->5714. Use {box} or {edge}. Confirm size near target groups is <=0.8x h before solving.

[general] Delivered box h is ~1.2-1.3x the request when the box is <1.4x finer than h or radius <=0.003 (0.0035 gave 0.0043). Request ~0.77x of desired h with radius >=0.004, else tighten or drop the box before solving.
[general] Box radius is inert for node count (h 0.007 lean recipe: 6164 nodes at r0.003 and r0.0015). Don't spend solves on box radius; change size or extent.
[general] Never spend a solve on uniform h coarsening of a recipe whose local refinements were inert: h 0.0063 (14.2k, ~23%) told nothing new; uniform h is break-even.
[abc_00000065_bc0] Baseline to beat: h 0.0078, wall box 0.0035 r0.003, edge 22 0.0025 r0.006, root 0.0025, pocket 0.003, f5/f7 sub-boxes 0.0016: 17634 DOFs, 8.38% field error, score 0.813.

[abc_00000065_bc0] Global h is dead above 0.0074-0.0078 with lean boxes. Nodes: 0.0078 5878, 0.0082 6784, 0.0095 6425, 0.0105 6335, 0.0112 6256, 0.0118 6408 (q 0.083 invalid). Never raise h above 0.0078. Keep quality.min >=0.105.

[abc_00000065_bc0] f7 sub-box misses hotspots y +0.0085 (9.8%, h 0.00288) and y -0.0083 (9.3%). Extend to [0.0235,-0.0125,-0.0081,0.0285,0.0105,-0.0055] at 0.0016; expect +100-150 nodes. a5's f7 extension to y -0.0145 gave 8.30% at 5765 nodes, best base 0.736: extent is the lever.

[abc_00000065_bc0] Sub-boxes at 0.0016 deliver h 0.0024-0.0026 where they reach. Extend EXTENT to hotspots rather than shrinking size below 0.0014 (0.0013 jumped to 6318 nodes). Top hotspots #1-#4 (f5/f7, z -0.0071) hold ~36% of error.

[abc_00000065_bc0] f5 sub-box misses hotspot #4 at f5 root y +0.008 (6.1%, h 0.0033). One-factor test after f7 extension: raise f5 sub-box ymax to 0.009 at 0.0016; keep only if SE gain >=0.03% per +1% DOFs.

[abc_00000065_bc0] Node count is non-monotone and branchy (wall 0.004 at h 0.0112 gave 6008 vs 6256 with 0.0035, higher SE). Free-mesh several h values first and take the cheapest valid; if quality <0.105 shift a box edge by 0.0002.
[abc_00000065_bc0] Solve plan: S1 f7 extension; S2 f5 ymax 0.009; S3 hotspot #5 box; S4 best with one fix. Never solve h 0.0074 (ties a1). compare finalists before submit.

[abc_00000065_bc0] REPEATED skip of view(error)/compare. After every solve view(kind=error, view=-z) and compare hotspot h against sub-box bounds: hotspot >0.0027 just outside a box means extend the box, not h.
[abc_00000065_bc0] Break-even: need >=0.03% SE per +1% DOFs. f7 extension at ~6000 nodes (+2%) must reach SE >=2.1352e-4 (from 2.13391e-4); a5's similar extension gave +0.044% for +1.3%.

[abc_00000065_bc0] Hidden worst point near f13 far strip (y≈-0.0375, h ~0.0055, 12% error); f52/f13 h 0.0072 at coarse h. Add a 0.0045 box only if DOFs rise <3%; >30% error share in far strip means coarser h costs points.
[abc_00000065_bc0] Solves 2 and 3 differed by 0.008% energy but 6% DOFs: submit the cheaper. Energy ties mean DOFs decide.
[abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Superseded: point recipe (8 points 0.0026) was inert: 20.2% at 17.1k DOFs, diversity bonus only. Don't reuse except as a diversity fallback.

[abc_00000003_bc7] Next call: mesh(h=0.005, order=2, refinements=[{f2,0.003,r0.005}, edges 40,39,8 at 0.0025 r0.004, box [-0.024,-0.014,0.019,0.024,0.014,0.036] 0.0029 r0.003]). Change ONLY sizes vs a3 (box 0.0033, edges 0.003). Target junction hotspot h<=0.0036. If nodes exceed ~9300, box 0.0030, not h.

[abc_00000003_bc7] a3 recipe is measured (h 0.005, 8067 nodes, 24201 DOFs, 0.033717 J, 16.7%): baseline, don't re-solve. Plan: S1 box 0.0029/edges 0.0025; S2 edges back to 0.003 to price edges; S3 box 0.0031/edges 0.0027; S4 refine best at top hotspot by size only. compare() the finalists.

[abc_00000003_bc7] Energy to field error this gen: 0.033717→16.7%, 0.033646→17.0%, 0.033554→17.3%, 0.033352→18.4%. Score≈(0.3186/e/2)^2×6057/DOFs. Submit the highest estimate, not a hunch (solve 2 est 0.23 beat submitted solve 1 0.218).

[abc_00000003_bc7] Break-even on this plateau: +10% DOFs must buy ≥+0.25-0.3% energy (~-0.8 to -1 pt error). Uniform h 0.005→0.0045 (+12%, +0.23%) and annulus (+11%, +0.22%) failed. Apply to the 0.0029 variant.

[abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Error estimate read ~13% when true field error was 16.5% (20-25% optimistic). Multiply estimate by ~1.25 before judging the 15.93% target.
[abc_00000003_bc7] Never drop {f2, 0.003, r0.005}: without it f2 h was 0.0047 and clamp-ring cells at z≈0.056 held 18.7% of error (a3 with f2: 16.7%, f2 h 0.0042).

[abc_00000003_bc7] Clamp annulus boxes (z 0.052-0.0585) at 0.0032-0.0035 r0.002 under h 0.0055 are a no-op: hotspot h 0.0042-0.0043, +773 nodes (+11% DOFs) for +0.22% energy; still 23% VM error. Don't reuse; if retried, 0.0026 with r0.004 on a tighter box.
[abc_00000003_bc7] Full-ring junction y ±0.0185 lowered y=±0.0129 junction cells to 2.25-2.53% (a3/a0 at y ±0.014: 2.5-3.0%). Pass to explorer and control; the variant keeps a3's box limits.
[abc_00000003_bc7] Lower barrel near f23 z≈0.005 (y≈+0.013, x≈-0.017) was 12% below consensus with h 0.0055 and no f2 group (f22/f24 h 0.0046). h 0.005 gives 0.0043: keep h 0.005.
[abc_00000003_bc7] Edges 40/39/8 at 0.003 inside a 0.0029 box are no-ops. When the box tightens keep edges ≥1.15x finer (0.0025), or measure them out with S2.

Need delivered size <=0.0025/r0.006, or point targets at the rims.

Keep f2 0.003 r0.005, don't go below 0.0025; optional single test f2 0.002/r0.004.

[abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Setup verified, identical across runs: 3D, fixed f2, 4 MPa on f23, 2.1 MPa on f16, E 210e9, nu 0.3. Error is purely discretization. Reuse verbatim; check f2 reactions vs applied load once.
